h1: Custom Etched Shirts for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom etched shirts in bulk. Perfect for teams and events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Etched shirts use a laser to remove fabric dye, creating a soft, breathable design that never cracks or peels. Unlike screen printing or embroidery, the artwork becomes part of the fabric itself, making it ideal for lightweight performance tees or moisture-wicking polos. Marketing directors and safety managers often choose etched logos for a modern, understated look that holds up wash after wash without adding bulk or weight.
heroAltText: Group of custom etched shirts with laser-removed dye logo designs on performance fabric
